title: Run a function over a struct
hints: There are two repairs. `body` never reads the field `r3`, and `run` calls `f` only once.
In `body`, the value to store is `k->r3 + r`. In `run`, you need a `for` loop whose counter goes from 0 to `n - 1`.
`run` becomes `for (int32_t r = 0; r < n; r++) { f(r, ctx); }`. When `n` is 0 the loop never calls `f`.
explain: `k->r3` reads the field `r3` through the pointer `k`, so `body` stores `k->r3 + r` into box `r` of the array. `run` calls the function it was handed once for each `r` below `n` and passes the same `ctx` pointer every time. With `n` equal to 0 nothing is called.
